description: This Java class handles the 'Unblock Savings Account' command within the Fineract project's savings portfolio module. It is responsible for invoking the service to unblock a specified savings account, identified by a command containing the account ID.

classes.name: UnblockSavingsAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: A handler class that processes commands to unblock savings accounts by delegating to the savings account service.

methods.name: UnblockSavingsAccountCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the savings account write platform service dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the unblocking command by calling the relevant service method with the account ID.
